Poker / In pictures

Poker, one panel at a time.

Poker comics from Nolan Kido: visual introductions to the game, with readable explanations alongside the artwork. Start with the table and betting, learn what beats what, then follow a hand through all four streets.

Comic 01 · October 14, 2026

Learn no-limit Hold’em

Meet the dealer button, small and big blinds, your two hole cards, and the first round of betting. Six panels to get a new player oriented.

AI-generated artwork, with a text version and rules notes.

Comic 02 · October 14, 2026

Poker hand rankings

What beats what? Follow the hands from royal flush to high card, with a readable ranking list and notes on aces, ties and the best five cards.

Comic 03 · October 14, 2026

One hand, four streets

Preflop, flop, turn, river: follow the action, see when betting happens, and learn the two ways a hand can end.
